chunks: Nor should you let them turn you away from the commandments of God once they have been delivered to you; and call them to your Lord, and do not be an idolater.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command the Prophet to do regarding divine revelations and inviting people to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet’s absolute fidelity to the revealed truth, warning against the subtle distractions of worldly power or polytheistic influences that could dilute the message of Tawhid. It serves as a perpetual directive for the Imams and the faithful to maintain doctrinal purity while actively inviting others to God, ensuring they remain distinct from those who associate partners with Allah.
